text: Lame, is he? Bring him here, and let me take a look at that foot.
speaker: p286

text: Easy, boy, easy. There. A stone, wedged tight under the shoe.
speaker: p286

text: And this nail's been driven too close. That's what's making him sore.
speaker: p286

text: I'll draw it, and set the shoe fast again. Rest him an hour, and lead him gently.
speaker: p286

text: There. He'll carry you home now. That's a penny for the work, if you please.
